patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-bleed dark backgrounds (black or orange) and white or light grey backgrounds, creating strong visual separation and contrast.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for impact, while body text uses a highly legible, slightly lighter sans-serif, maintaining a clear visual hierarchy.
A high-contrast palette of deep black and vibrant orange is used for primary branding, with white and light grey serving as clean background and text colors.

As the user scrolls, the main navigation bar shrinks in height and becomes sticky at the top of the viewport. Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.
A persistent, small video avatar widget floats in the bottom right corner of the screen on key product pages, offering an interactive element that showcases the core offering.

technique_notes: The navigation bar uses a scroll-triggered transformation to reduce its height and fix its position at the top of the viewport, likely using CSS transitions for a smooth effect. Sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements fade in and subtly slide upwards as they become visible, likely orchestrated with JavaScript (e.g., Intersection Observer) and CSS keyframes. The floating video avatar is a fixed-position element, potentially a Lottie animation or a live video feed, that remains visible on specific pages.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (hero ~4-5x body) with clear hierarchy, complemented by a readable, well-spaced body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card elements, maintaining a modern but not overly soft aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous padding in hero sections and good vertical rhythm between content blocks.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the seamless integration of AI-generated video avatars, not just as the product itself, but as a persistent, interactive UI element on key pages. This directly showcases the core offering in a dynamic and engaging way, reinforcing the brand's innovative identity.
